name: @speedora/dynamic-caption
description: Stateless module (JSON-in/JSON-out): AI Intelligence v4 Track B, Phase B1 - a pure, synchronous composition (no LLM call, no new detector - see docs/ai/subtitle-intelligence.md) that decides a size tier (small/normal/large) and animation (none/punch/attention) for every one of Phase A1's SubtitleTimeline lines, from Phase A1's own HighlightTimeline and Phase 5's EmotionalArc, with a rate-limited animation cooldown so caption motion stays a highlight, not a constant flicker. No DB/queue access at all; see root ARCHITECTURE.md. Consumed by apps/worker's render-graph captionTreatment node. Data only - wiring this into the actual ASS renderer is Phase B2's job.
